beats.text: This is Max. His barrier just lost to the river.
Max promised his kids the yard would stay dry forever.
Sand has wide gaps, so river water leaked through and collapsed it.
A packed clay core closed those gaps and stopped the leak.
Then buried sand carried pressure underneath, bursting through the lawn.
A heavy berm and relief wells released that hidden pressure safely.
Next, water crossed the low crest and gouged the bare slope.
Max raised the crest, then added grass and protective rock.
One squirrel tunnel became a muddy jet that carried soil away.
Packed repairs and regular checks stopped small holes becoming breaches.
Now every fix holds, and the trampoline stays dry. Which mistake surprised you?
